webhooks.detail: REST webhook subscriptions to Attio record/object/list/note/task etc. events; 25 req/s delivery cap per target URL, retries ~3 days.

evidence.quote: Webhooks allow you to subscribe to changes that happen in Attio

sandbox.detail: No sandbox/test-mode page found in docs, llms.txt index, or developer platform page. A developer console exists at build.attio.com (unverified); Attio has a free plan but docs do not document a dedicated sandbox.

evidence.quote: Connect your GTM stack with the REST API, App SDK, or Attio MCP.

rate_limits.summary: 100 req/s reads, 25 req/s writes; 429 with Retry-After

evidence.quote: Our rate limit across the whole API is 100 requests per second for read requests, 25 requests per second for write requests.
